name: HiBoP
description: `HiBoP` is an interactive application for visualizing human intracranial brain data, including iEEG, CCEP, fMRI, electrodes, anatomical MRI, and 3D brain meshes. It is designed for researchers who need to explore multimodal brain recordings in an intuitive 3D environment, linking signals, anatomy, and electrode localizations in a consistent and visual way.
releaseNotes:
- Reworked triangle erasing on Desktop and added it to Meta Quest, with selection previews, brush controls, and undo.
- Added contextual controller help on Quest and refreshed toolbar icons on both platforms.
- Improved Desktop–Quest scene transfers and fixed timeline jumps during fast scrubbing.
- Reduced atlas memory use, improved hover responsiveness, and fixed atlas loading and synchronization on Quest.
- Fixed Quest numeric keypads and group filters that reference patients outside the current project. Database updates now report inaccessible folders and continue scanning accessible ones.
